dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: Well then, Dexter. Times have changed. I suppose it's time for you to leave your childhood behind.

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: You, too, must submit to the baptism that we call a coming of age, learn of matters only grown-ups know. Watch closely, now. I shall only demonstrate this once.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why did that sound like someone giving their final words?

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: Your final lesson is as such. Read along with me — "The classification of the elements." Now, you try it.

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: I wish I could imitate Istoria and exclaim, "Excellent"! Alas, I cannot bring myself to...

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: Clearly, I have nothing left to teach you. That concludes the final lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait a second! You didn't teach a thing — {NICKNAME} did it all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on. Who exactly were you praising there?

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: Now then, the next step is to consider how things influence one another.

dialogues.speaker: Josephus
dialogues.text: Observe the elemental reactions, the long-range forces, and the short-range forces. And remember to avoid unnecessary disturbances.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, what language are you speaking right now!?
